description: This file defines the class ContactsViewEdit, which extends ViewEdit, and manages the presentation logic for editing contact records in the SuiteCRM application. It contains methods to handle display customization, including portal info panels and JavaScript validation, and interacts with various global objects and configurations related to contact editing.

classes.name: ContactsViewEdit
classes.description: A custom view class for editing contact records, handling display modifications such as portal information panels and client-side validation scripts.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that sets the view to be used for subpanels and enables module quick create template.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Overrides the parent display method to process contact data, conditionally display portal information, and add client-side validation scripts.
